note:
New gate, ADR-0062, over addons/. Six offenders, all one accident in one file.

addons/stock/models/product_template.py defines each of these twice in class
ProductTemplate:

  _search_variant_quantity        568 -> 631
  _search_qty_available           582 -> 677
  _search_qty_available_virtual   585 -> 680
  _search_qty_incoming            588 -> 683
  _search_qty_outgoing            591 -> 686
  _resolve_diagram_products       772 -> 837

Python keeps the last, so in every pair it is the LOWER, older long-hand that
runs and the upper, refactored one that is dead. The refactor itself landed:
every helper the dead block calls exists in the tree --
product_product._search_quantity_totals (:548), _quantity_search_domain (:568),
_get_quantity_search_candidates (:990) and tools/quantity.filter_quantity_in_python
(:12). Only the deletion of the superseded block was missed.

Floored rather than fixed here, deliberately. Deleting the second definition of
each is not a no-op -- it makes the newer implementation the one that runs --
and the stock/mrp dependency ring already carries standing failures that make
attribution expensive. That is its own commit, with that ring measured before
and after, not a drive-by inside the commit that adds the gate.
